Atlantic coastal waters from Jupiter Inlet to Ocean Reef out to
60 nm and Gulf coastal waters from East Cape Sable to Chokoloskee
out 20 nm and Chokoloskee to Bonita Beach out 60 nm...including the

Seas are provided as a range of the average height of the highest
1/3 of the waves...along with the occasional height of the average
highest 10 percent of the waves. 

AMZ600-GMZ606-192000-
241 AM EST Thu Nov 19 2026

.Synopsis for Jupiter Inlet to Ocean Reef FL out to 60 nm and for
East Cape Sable to Bonita Beach FL out to 60 nm...

Gusty east-northeasterly winds will continue across Atlantic waters
today, while winds across Gulf waters should drop below Small Craft
Advisory criteria by this afternoon. A Small Craft Advisory remains
in effect for Gulf waters through early this afternoon, and Atlantic
waters through Friday evening. Wave heights are expected to reach
the 8-10 foot range for Atlantic waters and 2-3 feet for Gulf waters
through this evening. Winds and waves could become locally higher in
any shower or thunderstorm activity. 

Gulf Stream Hazards: Sustained winds of 20-30 knots with higher
gusts, and wave heights of 8-10 feet.

The approximate location of the west wall of the Gulf Stream as of
Nov 18, 2026.

 22 nautical miles north northeast of Fowey Rocks.
  7 nautical miles east of Port Everglades.
  6 nautical miles south southeast of Lake Worth.
  6 nautical miles east northeast of Jupiter Inlet.
